lines.en: label christmastwo12:
scene yuricouch1
: Excuse me, but I was wondering if any of you would be able to tell me where I could find some lesbians.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，不知道你们谁能告诉我，在哪里可以找到一些女同性恋。

lines.en: : I’d be more than happy to point you in the right direction if you’d be willing to tell me what you intend to do with them.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意告诉我你打算拿她们做什么，我很乐意给你指条明路。

lines.en: : Nodoka, are you actually drinking or have you just been holding that wine glass to look sophisticated all night?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你是真的在喝，还是整晚只是端着那杯红酒装成熟？

lines.en: : Oh, she’s drinking alright. Nodoka just has weirdly high alcohol tolerance.
lines.zh: : 哦，她可是在喝。Nodoka 只是酒量高得离谱。

lines.en: scene yuricouch2
: I must remain vigilant at all times. You never know when a beautiful woman might show up and attempt to bed me.
lines.zh: : 我必须时刻保持警惕。你永远不知道什么时候会有个美女出现，试图把我弄上床。

lines.en: : I think she’s just a really calm drunk. It’s not like we can really judge by any of the things she’s saying since she’s always saying...Nodoka things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她只是醉得很平静的那种。反正也不能凭她说的话来判断，因为她一直在说……Nodoka 式的话。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is that Nodoka is the cool one and you two are just losers.
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，Nodoka 是那个酷的，你们俩就是废物。

lines.en: scene yuricouch3
: There something wrong with being a loser now?
lines.zh: : 当废物现在有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : We just don’t really like alcohol. We tried it at the dorm war fashion show thing and we both thought it was kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 我们只是真的不喜欢酒。我们在宿舍战争时装秀那次试过，都觉得挺恶心的。

lines.en: : It’s like our taste buds are totally in sync or something.
lines.zh: : 就像我们的味蕾完全同步什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah! And it was even more like that last night when they were touching each other!
lines.zh: : 对！而且昨晚她们互相摸的时候更像！

lines.en: scene yuricouch4
: Well, I guess that’s a thing Sensei knows now. That was a fun secret for twenty hours.
lines.zh: : 嗯，看来这件事老师现在也知道了。这个秘密还挺好玩的，维持了二十个小时。

lines.en: : Congratulations? I’m not really sure what to say here.
lines.zh: : 恭喜？我不太确定该说什么。

lines.en: : Then talk about something else, man.
lines.zh: : 那就聊点别的啊，兄弟。

lines.en: : How was it?
lines.zh: : 感觉怎么样？

lines.en: scene yuricouch5
: Or be even weirder about it.
lines.zh: : 或者在这件事上表现得更怪一点。

lines.en: : It was awesome.
lines.zh: : 太棒了。

lines.en: : And it wasn’t even me who made the first move! How crazy is that?!
lines.zh: : 而且先出手的还不是我！是不是很疯狂？！

lines.en: scene yuricouch6
: Oh? Otoha conveniently left that detail out when I made her describe the night to me in vivid detail.
lines.zh: : 哦？我让 Otoha 绘声绘色地跟我描述那一晚的时候，她可是“贴心”地略过了这个细节。

lines.en: : If she skimped on that aspect, who knows what else she could have possibly left out?
lines.zh: : 如果她在这一部分偷工减料，谁知道她还可能漏掉了什么？

lines.en: : Okay, first off, you really don’t need to keep a diary of every single lesbian experience I have.
lines.zh: : 好吧，首先，你真的没必要把我每一次的女同性恋经历都记成日记。

lines.en: : I do, but please continue on with your second point.
lines.zh: : 我有必要，不过请继续说你的第二点。

lines.en: : Second, does it really matter who initiated it? It was just a kiss. It’s not like it was a big deal or whatever.
lines.zh: : 第二，谁先主动真的重要吗？不过是个吻而已。又不是什么大事。

lines.en: : It was a bunch of kisses and it was a very big deal.
lines.zh: : 那是一大串吻，而且是件非常重大的事。

lines.en: scene yuricouch7
: Uhh...anyway! How’s your...Christmas? You warming up to the new teacher yet?
lines.zh: : 呃……总之！你的……圣诞节过得怎么样？你开始接受新老师了吗？

lines.en: : They’re basically joined at the genitals already.
lines.zh: : 她们基本上已经连在一起了，连的是生殖器。

lines.en: : I believe the phrase is joined at the hip.
lines.zh: : 我想那句话应该是“形影不离”。

lines.en: scene yuricouch8
: You think I don’t know that?
lines.zh: : 你以为我不知道吗？

lines.en: : So I take it she’s here to stay then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜她是打算留下了？

lines.en: : Do you not want her around or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不希望她在之类的？

lines.en: : Nah, it’s nothing like that. I was just finally starting to get the hang of never worrying about homework and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不，不是那么回事。我只是终于开始习惯“永远不用操心作业什么的”了。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I doubt Imani is going to change anything about how the class is run. So there’s a high chance of you just never having homework again for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，我怀疑 Imani 不会改变班级的任何运作方式。所以你很有可能这辈子都不用再写作业了。

lines.en: : I think you mean the rest of the school year.
lines.zh: : 我想你要说的是“这学年剩下的日子”。

lines.en: : I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我就是字面意思。

lines.en: : Interesting. It sounds to me like Sensei might have a little information that he isn’t willing to share with the class.
lines.zh: : 有意思。听起来老师好像掌握了一些不愿意和全班分享的情报。

lines.en: : If I shared everything I know with all of you, none of you would ever be able to look at me again.
lines.zh: : 如果我把我知道的一切都告诉你们，你们没有一个人还能再正视我。

lines.en: : Ew.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: : I would.
lines.zh: : 我可以。

lines.en: : I would too. But only if Otoha is cool with it. If she’s not, I’ll pretend that I’m not into it, but I totally will be. Just in secret. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我也可以。不过前提是 Otoha 不介意。如果她介意，我就装作不感兴趣，但其实我会偷偷感兴趣。对。

lines.en: scene yuricouch9
: Ugh. Well, speaking of shit I’m not into, the woes continue.
lines.zh: : 呃。好吧，说到我不感兴趣的事，烦心事还在继续。

lines.en: : Parents again?
lines.zh: : 又是父母？

lines.en: : They’re really all over you tonight, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 他们今晚可真是把你缠得死死的啊。

lines.en: : Yuuuuuup. But I guess I can kind of understand where they’re coming from since it’s the first Christmas I’ve had away from home.
lines.zh: : 是—————啊。不过我多少能理解他们的出发点，毕竟这是我第一个不在家过的圣诞节。

lines.en: : Can you tell them I said hi this time?
lines.zh: : 这次你能替我跟他们问好吗？

lines.en: : No. And stop asking that.
lines.zh: : 不能。别再问了。

lines.en: : Can you tell them I said hi?
lines.zh: : 你能替我说声嗨吗？

lines.en: scene yuricouch10
: What? No. Go away. You’ve already ruined any chance of ever talking to either one of my parents.
lines.zh: : 什么？不行。走开。你已经彻底毁掉了我和我爸妈任何一个人说话的可能性。

lines.en: : Are you still torn up over the porn thing?
lines.zh: : 你还在为色情片那件事纠结吗？

lines.en: : Porn thing? Have you been watching porn with my girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 色情片的事？你一直在和我女朋友一起看色情片？

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Does that mean what I think it means?
lines.zh: : 是我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: : Are you planning on fucking me over again?
lines.zh: : 你打算再坑我一次？

lines.en: : No, Rin.
lines.zh: : 不，Rin。

lines.en: scene yuricouch11
: Right, I never told you. But he was in my dorm room when my mom called one night and his first thought was to start quoting some fucking raunchy ass porn video he memorized.
lines.zh: : 对了，我还没告诉过你。有天晚上我妈打电话来的时候他就在我宿舍里，而他的第一反应是开始背诵他背下来的某段他妈的淫秽色情影片台词。

lines.en: : Unfortunate. If I were there as well, I would have joined in on the fun.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。如果当时我也在，我会加入一起玩的。

lines.en: : You know we can always just make our own fun. Right, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你知道我们随时可以自己制造乐趣。对吧，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Let me hold this wine glass and pretend to be sophisticated for a few more hours before I get back to you.
lines.zh: : 让我再端着这杯酒装几个小时成熟，然后再回复你。

lines.en: : If it makes you any more comfortable, I promise I won’t make any sex noises if you tell your parents I said hi.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点，我保证只要你替我向父母问好，我不会发出任何性爱的声音。

lines.en: : Well, can’t say that’s a sentence I expected to hear tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可真是我今晚没料到会听到的一句话。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m just texting them anyway. It’s literally impossible for them to hear anything like that through a text.
lines.zh: : 再说，我只是给他们发短信而已。他们根本不可能通过短信听到任何那种声音。

lines.en: : Did you hear that, Sensei? We’re free to make as many lewd noises as we want.
lines.zh: : 你听到了吗，老师？我们可以尽情发出多少下流声音都行。

lines.en: scene yuricouch12
: Okay, as unsurprised as everyone here would be if the two of you decided to do that, I’m going to ask you to not.
lines.zh: : 好吧，虽然这里所有人要是看到你们俩真这么做都不会感到意外，但我还是要请你们别这样。

lines.en: : I kind of need my ears to work if I’m ever going to be a singer and I’m afraid that hearing either of you two moaning or...grunting would kinda ruin that career path for me.
lines.zh: : 我以后还想当歌手，耳朵得能用才行，我怕听到你们俩任何一个呻吟或者……哼哼，会毁掉我的职业道路。

lines.en: : I think you’ll make it no matter what the two of them do, Otoha. You’re so talented. It’s amazing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不管她们俩做什么，你都会成功的，Otoha。你太有才华了。真了不起。

lines.en: scene yuricouch13
: Huh? What? Me? Stop.
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？我？别说了。

lines.en: : I mean it. Seeing you working so hard every day, like...makes me want to give it my best too.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。看着你每天那么努力，就……让我也想全力以赴。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not every day...
lines.zh: : 我是说……也不是每天都……

lines.en: : Then however many days it is- which feels like a lot to me, but I guess that could be just because I always want to be around you.
lines.zh: : 那不管是几天——对我来说感觉很多，不过大概只是因为我总想待在你身边吧。

lines.en: : Here they go. Kumon-mi’s newest power couple- getting their yuri all over the couch.
lines.zh: : 又来了。Kumon-mi 最新的一对神仙眷侣——把百合气息蹭得沙发上到处都是。

lines.en: : I just...have to stay focused or I’ll fall behind, you know?
lines.zh: : 我只是……必须保持专注，否则就会落后，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I know that I can get a little too sucked in while writing music and stuff, but you can always...I don’t know, try and tell me to stop if you really...want to see me or something.
lines.zh: : 我知道我写歌的时候会陷得太深，不过你可以……我不知道，如果你真的……想见我的话，试着让我停下来也行。

lines.en: : Wow, you two really are getting your yuri all over the couch.
lines.zh: : 哇，你们俩是真的把百合气息蹭得沙发上到处都是。

lines.en: : I feel really sorry for whatever cleaning crew is tasked with-
lines.zh: : 我真同情负责——的清洁工

lines.en: : Ring ring ring~
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring~

lines.en: : Hm?
scene yuricouch14
: Yasu?
lines.zh: : Yasu？

lines.en: : Ring ring ring. It comes in threes.
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring。它三下三下地来。

lines.en: : Ring ring ring. It shakes the trees.
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring。它撼动树木。

lines.en: : Ring ring ring. It burns your eyes.
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring。它灼烧你的眼睛。

lines.en: : Ring ring ring. Surprise, surprise.
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring。惊喜，惊喜。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Something is here.
lines.zh: : 有什么东西来了。

lines.en: : I hope it’s an ambulance because I think you may have snapped.
lines.zh: : 我希望那是辆救护车，因为我觉得你可能已经崩溃了。

lines.en: : Snapped?
lines.zh: : 崩溃？

lines.en: : Gone insane. Lost all grip on reality.
lines.zh: : 疯掉了。彻底脱离现实。

lines.en: : Aren’t you the one who’s losing grip, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，脱离现实的难道不是你吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : You’ll find out soon.
lines.zh: : 你很快就会知道的。

lines.en: : Ring ring ring~
lines.zh: : Ring ring ring~

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu-

lines.en: scene yuricouch15
: Oh my- are you fucking kidding me? Why do they have to call?
lines.zh: : 哦我的天——你他妈在跟我开玩笑吧？他们为什么要打电话？

lines.en: : You’re...not going to have to leave, are you?
lines.zh: : 你……不会要走了吧？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. God forbid I actually get to relax for a single night without having to check in with my parents every two minutes.
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道。老天爷啊，难道我连一个晚上都不能好好放松，不用每隔两分钟就跟父母报备一次吗。

lines.en: : Just don’t answer. What are they going to do about it?
lines.zh: : 别接不就行了。他们能拿你怎么样？

lines.en: : Stop paying for my vocal lessons? Stop paying for my phone bill? I don’t have a job. I can’t afford all of this on my own.
lines.zh: : 不再付我的声乐课钱？不再付我的手机账单？我没有工作。我自己负担不起这一切。

lines.en: : Otoha-
lines.zh: : Otoha-

lines.en: : Just...give me a second...
lines.zh: : 就……给我一点时间……

lines.en: scene black
scene yuricouch16
: The smile, the face...the light before dawn...
lines.zh: : 那微笑，那张脸……黎明前的光……

lines.en: : It’s buried beneath us...
lines.zh: : 它被埋在我们脚下……

lines.en: : And...everything’s...
lines.zh: : 还有……一切都……

lines.en: : Oh.
: I can’t hear it.
lines.zh: : 我听不见了。

lines.en: scene yuricouch17
: What?...
: Um...Sir? Do you mind if I just...stand near you for a second?...I felt awkward with Otoha just...right in front of me...
lines.zh: : 嗯……老师？介意我……就站在你旁边一会儿吗？……Otoha 就在我面前……让我觉得挺尴尬的……

lines.en: : Mom? What do you want? I already told you I was spending Christmas with my friends this year.
lines.zh: : 妈？你想干什么？我都说了今年圣诞节要和朋友一起过。

lines.en: scene yuricouch18
: What are you talking about? I absolutely did tell you.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我绝对说过。

lines.en: : Then check your fucking text messages and-
lines.zh: : 那就去看看你他妈的短信，然后——

lines.en: : Yes! I did mean to curse! You’re being totally unfair!
lines.zh: : 对！我就是故意骂人的！你太不讲理了！

lines.en: : Because I’d rather just be with my friends this year! It’s not like I’m quitting the family or something.
lines.zh: : 因为我今年就是想和朋友在一起！我又不是要退出这个家什么的。

lines.en: scene yuricouch19
: Well, what did Dad say? Because...
lines.zh: : 那爸爸怎么说？因为……

lines.en: : Can you at least put him on? Because I highly doubt he’s making as big of a deal out of this as you are.
lines.zh: : 你至少能让他接电话吗？因为我非常怀疑他会像你一样把这事闹得这么大。

lines.en: scene yuricouch20
: Fine! Whatever! I'll come back!
lines.zh: : 行！随便吧！我回去就是了！

lines.en: : But it makes literally zero sense that I’m old enough to live in the dorms, but not old enough to-
lines.zh: : 但这完全说不通啊——我大到可以住校了，却还不够大到可以——

lines.en: scene yuricouch21
: Did...
: Did she really just hang up on me?..
lines.zh: : 她真的就这么挂我电话了？……

lines.en: scene black
scene yuricouch22
: So, uhh...that didn’t sound like it went too well.
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……听起来不太顺利啊。

lines.en: : It didn’t. And now I have a headache, so that’s wonderful.
lines.zh: : 确实不顺利。而且我现在头还疼，真是太好了。

lines.en: : What...happened?
lines.zh: : 发生……什么了？

lines.en: : My mom is pissed off because apparently being born into the Okakura family means you’re not allowed to spend Christmas with your friends or something.
lines.zh: : 我妈气炸了，因为显然生在 Okakura 家就意味着你不能和朋友过圣诞节什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know- it’s just one more stupid rule out of the hundred million of them I have to put up with on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道——这不过是我每天要忍受的一亿条蠢规矩里又多了一条。

lines.en: scene yuricouch23
: So...you’re leaving? Like...now?
lines.zh: : 所以……你要走了？像……现在？

lines.en: : I guess. Especially since I was spot on with the “I’m holding your career and communication” hostage thing. That was one of the first things she jumped to.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。特别是我那句“我用你的事业和通讯录当人质”还说得分毫不差。这是她最先跳起来的点之一。

lines.en: : Well...how much are your lessons? Maybe I can save up enough from the cafe for-
lines.zh: : 那个……你的课多少钱？也许我能从咖啡馆攒够钱——

lines.en: scene yuricouch24
: Rin, no. Use your money to buy yourself new basketball shorts or...get your guitar set up or something. I’m not going to let you use it on me.
lines.zh: : Rin，不行。拿你的钱给自己买条新篮球裤，或者……去弄好你的吉他什么的。我不会让你把钱花在我身上。

lines.en: : But if it’s to support your passion, I-
lines.zh: : 可如果是为了支持你的热爱，我——

lines.en: : My passion will be fine. My Christmas on the other hand...well, the tail end of that is pretty much fucked.
lines.zh: : 我的热爱不会有事。但我的圣诞节……嗯，后半截基本是完蛋了。

lines.en: scene yuricouch25
: It...doesn’t have to be?
lines.zh: : 也……不一定非得这样吧？

lines.en: : What? No, it kind of does. Like, I don’t really have a choice. I have to go back to my parents or we won’t be able to text each other weird emojis at random hours of the night anymore.
lines.zh: : 什么？不，就是非得这样。我其实没得选。我必须回父母那儿去，不然我们就再也不能在深夜的随便几点互发奇怪的表情符号了。

lines.en: : I know you have to leave, but...what if I came with you?
lines.zh: : 我知道你得走，但是……如果我跟你一起去呢？

lines.en: scene yuricouch26
: Like...downstairs? I figured you would walk me to the lobby anyway, so-
lines.zh: : 像……去楼下？我本来以为你会送我到大堂，所以——

lines.en: : No, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 不，Otoha……

lines.en: : To your parents’ house...
lines.zh: : 去你父母家……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: We’ve been, like...dating for a little while now and I still have no idea what they’re like and-
lines.zh: : 我们，怎么说……也交往了一段时间了，而我到现在都不知道他们是什么样的人，然后——

lines.en: scene yuricouch27
: Okay, uhh...yeah. That’s probably not a good idea.
lines.zh: : 好，呃……嗯。这大概不是个好主意。

lines.en: : I obviously really like you, but there’s no reason for you to meet my parents.
lines.zh: : 我明显很喜欢你，但你没有理由去见我的父母。

lines.en: : It’s going to be like, really boring anyway. Like, I’m probably just going to go to sleep when I get there.
lines.zh: : 而且到时候反正会，怎么说，无聊得要死。我大概到了那儿就直接睡了。

lines.en: : Is being in a relationship really not a good enough reason to meet them?...
lines.zh: : 谈恋爱这件事，难道还不足以成为见他们的理由吗？……

lines.en: : It’s really not. I mean, I haven’t met your parents either so like, it’s obviously not just a me thing.
lines.zh: : 真的不足以。我是说，我也没见过你的父母，所以这显然不只是我一个人的问题。

lines.en: scene yuricouch28
: You can meet them whenever you want! They’ve actually been wondering when they’d get to see you ever since we started dating.
lines.zh: : 你想见随时可以见！从我们开始交往起，他们还一直在猜什么时候能见到你呢。

lines.en: : Do your parents like...not want to meet me or something?
lines.zh: : 你父母是……不想见我之类的吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene yuricouch29
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Do your parents...
lines.zh: : 你父母……

lines.en: : Even know about me?...
lines.zh: : 根本知道有我这个人吗？……

lines.en: : Do...they have to?
lines.zh: : 他们……非得知道吗？

lines.en: scene yuricouch30
: Rin, it’s nothing against you. Really.
lines.zh: : Rin，这不是针对你。真的。

lines.en: : But...I don’t understand. I know I can be like, clingy and annoying sometimes, but I still think I’m a good person more often than not.
lines.zh: : 可是……我不明白。我知道我有时候，怎么说，很黏人很烦，但我还是觉得自己大部分时候是个好人。

lines.en: : Is it just because it’s Christmas? Can I maybe...meet them eventually? I just don’t understand why you have to hide-
lines.zh: : 只是因为今天是圣诞节吗？我能不能……以后再见他们？我只是不明白你为什么非得把我藏起来——

lines.en: scene yuricouch31
: It’s because you’re a fucking girl, dude.
lines.zh: : 因为你他妈的是个女的，兄弟。

lines.en: : Because I’m...
lines.zh: : 因为我是……

lines.en: : But...what does-
lines.zh: : 可是……这有什么——

lines.en: : We can’t all have fucking...cool, accepting, lesbian parents like you.
lines.zh: : 我们不可能都像你一样，有那么……酷、那么包容的同性恋父母。

lines.en: : If my parents found out I was dating a girl, I'd be literally fucked. They’d take everything away from me.
lines.zh: : 如果我父母发现我在和一个女生交往，我就彻底完了。他们会把我的一切都收走。

lines.en: : And I just...can’t risk that sort of thing right now.
lines.zh: : 而我只是……现在不能冒这个险。

lines.en: : But, uhh...maybe one day when I can like, support myself and shit. If we’re even still together by then.
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……也许等哪天我能，怎么说，养活自己什么的。如果我们到那时还在一起的话。

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 这话什么意思？

lines.en: scene yuricouch32
: Just that I know I sound like a real asshole right now.
lines.zh: : 只是说，我知道我现在听起来像个十足的混蛋。

lines.en: : Listen, can I maybe...call you about this later? I don’t really want to do this in front of the whole class.
lines.zh: : 听着，我能……晚点再打电话跟你说这事吗？我真的不想在全班面前谈这个。

lines.en: scene yuricouch33
: Will you even be able to? What if your parents overhear you talking to a girl? Is that going to get you in trouble?
lines.zh: : 你还能打吗？要是你父母听到你在跟一个女生说话怎么办？那会给你惹麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Rin, I’m sorry...Really.
lines.zh: : Rin，对不起……真的。

lines.en: scene yuricouch34
: Yeah, I know. But, uhh...at least we’re still dating! That’s...good! Anyway, enjoy Christmas with your parents!
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。不过，呃……至少我们还在交往！这……挺好的！总之，祝你和父母圣诞快乐！

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin-

lines.en: : Please leave the room now. I don’t want to cry in front of you.
lines.zh: : 请现在离开房间。我不想在你面前哭。

lines.en: : I’m really sorry...
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉……

lines.en: scene yuricouch35
Otoha awkwardly exits the room without making eye contact with anyone.
lines.zh: Otoha 尴尬地走出房间，没有和任何人眼神接触。

lines.en: And as much as I want to condemn her for her actions tonight...I can’t.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想为她今晚的所作所为定罪……但我做不到。

lines.en: She’s a [teenage]girl caught in the clutches of an iron fist capable of squeezing her until she bursts at the drop of a hat.
lines.zh: 她只是个 [teenage]女孩，被一只铁拳攥在手里，随时都可能被捏到爆裂。

lines.en: It only makes sense that she’d want to preserve her feelings over that of someone else- even if that person is someone she’s decided to commit to.
lines.zh: 她想保住自己的感受而不是别人的——哪怕那个人是她决定托付的人——这也完全说得通。

lines.en: “Commit” in the loosest possible sense of the word, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这里的“托付”是最宽松意义上的。

lines.en: It’s hard to assign a high score to any sort of commitment that allows you to leave the room with your partner on the verge of emotional collapse.
lines.zh: 任何一种允许你撇下濒临情绪崩溃的伴侣走出房间的承诺，都很难打高分。

lines.en: Maybe Otoha’s just a bad person.
lines.zh: 也许 Otoha 就是个坏人。

lines.en: Or maybe she’s just grown so used to Rin being on the verge of collapsing that when her knees start to buckle a little more than normal, she has a tough time noticing.
lines.zh: 又或者，她只是太习惯看 Rin 摇摇欲坠了，所以当 Rin 的膝盖比平常弯得更厉害一点时，她很难察觉。

lines.en: I can forgive her for that.
lines.zh: 这一点我可以原谅她。

lines.en: What everyone else decides to do with it is entirely on them.
lines.zh: 其他人打算拿这件事怎么办，就完全是他们自己的事了。

lines.en: : Let’s sit down.
lines.zh: : 我们坐下吧。

lines.en: scene yuricouch36
: I’m here. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我在。没事的。

lines.en: : All I wanted was-
lines.zh: : 我只是想要——

lines.en: : We can talk about it later if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我们晚点再聊。

lines.en: : Just take a second to sit down and breathe right now. Trust me.
lines.zh: : 现在先坐下来喘口气就好。相信我。
